dct_title_s: Vegetation Features - Points (Digital Map Database of China)
dct_description_sm: Abstract: This coverage contains vegetation features throughout China, represented by points. Vegetation polygons less than 1.5 square millimeters on the source map are represented as points. These features include mangrove forests, economically exploited forests (bamboo, coffee, etc.), shrub and grassland areas. Not all vegetation types found in China are represented in this coverage.

Purpose: These data are intended for researchers, students, and policy makers for reference and mapping purposes, and to provide users with geographic data for cartography, environmental monitoring, management and impact analysis, land use and economic analysis and other types of geographic analysis. Data can be used with geographic information systems (GIS) software to display and analyze information on land cover and associated areas of interest, or to provide a basemap to support graphical overlays and analysis with other spatial data.
